description: A warm, daylight-focused editorial design system. Avoids corporate SaaS and dark AI-slop aesthetics by using tactile paper textures, rich academic typography, and organic colors. Designed to feel energetic yet structured for university students.

headings.usage: H1-H3, hero sections, announcement titles. Use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Main UI, queries, general text. Highly legible sans.

mono.usage: Encrypted Author IDs, timestamps, small metadata.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain filter over the main background to give a tactile paper feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient clay-like shadows. shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(42,71,71,0.08)]. Inner 1px border on cards to separate from background.
visual_enhancers.borders: Cards and sidebar use 1px solid border-default to ground the design (Swiss/Editorial feel).

components.sidebar: Fixed left, distinct background (#F4F2EC). Grouped links (Announcements, Queries, Clubs, Complaints, Admin) with @phosphor-icons/react icons.
components.announcement_feed: Magazine-style layout. Large serif titles, crisp date borders. Composer locked to CR/DCR.
components.attendance_tracker: Bento-style grid of subject cards. Include SVG percentage rings. Use primary brand color for high attendance, warning colors for low.
components.query_cards: Tactile card styling. Header includes 'Encrypted ID' chip (mono font) and escalation status timeline (48h -> Senior -> Alumni -> Archived).
components.club_grid: Image-heavy bento grid. Each club card features a photo from the image list, club name in serif, and a pill for cell type. 'Past 5-year archives' shown as a sub-nav timeline.
components.role_badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), highly legible text, 1px border. Uses colors defined in 'roles'.
components.auth_pages: Split screen. Left: warm daylight campus image, right: login/register form with Shadcn selects for Department & Year.

grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use for Attendance Tracker and Club Overviews.
grids_layouts.feed_layout: Max width 3xl for readability, centered within its container (optical alignment), padded generously (p-8).
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-8 between major sections.

motion.stagger: List items (queries, announcements) stagger entrance via framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within colored role badges and encrypted chips, meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Use charcoal text instead of white on lighter brand colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (tabs, forms, buttons, cards) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='announcement-composer').

hero_login.description: Students talking and laughing in a lecture hall. Ideal for login page or hero section.

club_news_announcements.description: Club news sign with poster above snacks and lamp. Great for announcement headers or club dashboard.

archive_tactile.description: Newspapers laid out on a wooden table. Perfect for representing the 'Past 5-year event archives' visually.

club_group.description: A group of people standing in front of a building. Use for club cover photos.

instructions_to_main_agent: PHASE 1: Setup the layout frame. Create a responsive Left Sidebar + Top Header (mobile) + Main Content Area. Main bg should be #F9F8F6.
PHASE 2: Build typography base in Tailwind config. Import Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.
PHASE 3: Develop the Core Components (RoleBadge, EncryptedIDChip, TactileCard). Ensure TactileCard has the 1px inner border and clay-like shadow.

PHASE 4: Construct the Dashboard Views. Implement the Attendance Rings (Bento Grid), the Magazine-style Announcement Feed (CR/DCR gated visually), and the Q&A Query Cards with the escalation timeline.
PHASE 5: Build the Auth Pages with the split layout using the provided auth_hero image.
PHASE 6: Integrate sonner for toasts and framer-motion for simple micro-interactions on the Query Cards and Club Grid.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic dark-slate/indigo gradients (AI slop).
Always use the defined tactile paper colors and editorial fonts. DO NOT fallback to Inter or Roboto for headings.
Create depth through 1px borders, subtle layered shadows, and noise textures. DO NOT rely on solid dark gray lines.
DO NOT use a completely transparent background for headers, sidebars, or dropdowns. Always use solid #F4F2EC or glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur).
All interactive elements MUST have micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
You MUST include data-testid attributes on all form fields, buttons, links, and major content cards.
Implement the 'Encrypted ID' visual using JetBrains Mono, a lock icon, and a subtle blurred or dotted background.
Do NOT use HTML-based generic alerts. Use 'sonner' for all notifications.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography to match the academic/editorial aesthetic.
